data.summary: Caller enquired about a 3BHK redesign in Aundh.
data.transcript:
[12:19:14] AGENT: Hello, Aangan Studio. How can I help?

[12:19:19] USER: Hi, I have a 3BHK in Aundh, about 1,100 sq ft. I want to redo the kitchen, wardrobes and living room.

[12:19:40] AGENT: Lovely. When would you like to start?
